policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Pipework Fracture and External Surfaces Edition
description: Due to an extended period of extremely cold temperatures, frost damage occurred to the house. Parts of the exterior plaster cracked and fell off the facade. Separately, a fitting inside also failed from the cold, and a thermal imaging camera had to be used to locate exactly where before it could be repaired.

lines.4: Auxiliary and cleaning material 1 flat rate
lines.6: Thermal imaging camera (leak detection) 1 flat rate
lines.7: Facade water and frost damage 1 pcs
